about: What the title folder is made of, and for each part its licence, the licence texts that travel with it and where its source is.
shell/ps5/release/stage-notices.py reads this table after a build and writes LEGAL.txt and licenses/ into the title folder:
the texts, a components.json that ties every file to the part it belongs to and the revision it was built from, and a README.txt.
Paths are relative to the repository; ${VULKAN} is PS5_VULKAN_DIR (../PS5_Vulkan), ${MESA} ../PS5_Mesa, ${SDK} PS5_PAYLOAD_SDK,
'in-tree' sources are in this repository (Flycast's core/deps and its submodules), at the revision the repository records.

components.modifications: Made for this project. icon0.png is the app's mark and name, drawn by shell/ps5/sce_sys/make-icon.py. pic0.dds (the home screen) is the mark and the name as the start-up animation has them, and pic1.dds (while the title loads) the animation's first frame; both are rendered from the interface's own code (shell/ps5/bigpicture.cpp) and encoded with PS5_Vulkan's tools/prepare-assets.sh. sounds/startup.wav is the output of shell/ps5/sounds/make-startup-sound.html, which makes every sound in it from oscillators and noise: nothing in it is sampled or recorded.
